title: Define computer-use booter, component, tool, and skill-sync boundaries
description: AstrBot's computer-use surface combines local/remote sandbox booters, shell/python/filesystem/browser components, sandbox skill synchronization, tool discovery, capabilities, and prompt fragments. Rust should isolate those as a separate computer-use boundary before tool execution or agent runner code grows this surface directly.

files.change: Keep local, hosted, and remote sandbox lifecycle behind typed booter traits.
Model shell, Python, filesystem, and browser components independently from tool declarations.
Separate skill bundle upload, apply, scan, and cache refresh from agent/tool execution.

criteria: Computer-use tools enter the generic tool catalog through typed declarations.
Sandbox lifecycle and component capabilities do not live in the plugin SDK or ProcessStage.
Skill synchronization is testable without booting a real remote sandbox.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-plugin && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
